author: Willian Justen de Vasconcellos
why: Recognisable elevated view of the citadel, green terraces and Huayna Picchu amid atmospheric mountain mist. Strong central composition for 9:10; softer colour than a clear-sky view.

author: Fabien Moliné
why: Photographer identifies Machu Picchu, Peru; broad view of the ruins and surrounding green mountains. Full-size image endpoint; pixel dimensions unconfirmed.

author: Maria Camila Castaño
why: 4480 × 5600; Machu Picchu with Huayna Picchu behind and blue sky. Portrait framing is especially convenient for a 9:10 card.

author: Anyela Málaga
why: 2667 × 4000; recognisable ruins-and-Huayna-Picchu composition with green terraces. Strong option for a near-square crop.

author: Nino Okruashvili
why: Elevated Machu Picchu ruins with the surrounding Andes and lush greenery. Full-resolution download linked; dimensions unverified.

author: Paolo Salazar
why: Cloud-wrapped Machu Picchu with terraces and mountain backdrop; atmospheric alternative to clear-sky views. Dimensions unverified.

author: Kaushik Mahadevan
why: 4032 × 3024 landscape with ancient ruins and misty hills; ample resolution for a 9:10 crop.

author: Kimberly Alves
why: 6000 × 4000 photograph with detailed terraces and stone architecture; substantial cropping latitude.
